Name: Wildflour's Whimsical Resources
Author: Wildflourmods
Description:
[font=Georgia][size=4][img]https://i.imgur.com/ZdF88SO.png[/img][/size]

[list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=5]A recolor of Anette's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15026]Simple Resources[/url]﻿ in a pastel/more whimsical color palette[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=5]birch/white wood for stumps and logs[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=5]pale blue rocks[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=5]bright, happy weeds[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=5]mine rocks in all levels of the mines![/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=5]recolored resources like ores, bars, tree seeds, battery pack etc[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=5]HIGHLY CONFIGURABLE - turn on/off any bit you don't want[/size][/font]
[*][size=5][b]Mods in Screenshots: [/b][url=https://cafe.naver.com/starvall/318899]OnOff's Mine Retexture[/url]﻿ from Naver(need login); [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Recolor[/url]﻿,  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9799?tab=files]Yri's Modular Recolor[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14649]Yri's Tree Overhaul[/url]﻿[/size]
[/list][/font][font=Georgia]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/WHc7ow2.png[/img]

[size=5]HUGE Thank you to [url=https://pixerelia.itch.io/]Atelier Pixerelia[/url], who I commission regularly for sprites and who allows me to modify them to my heart's content. I could not do this without you!

ANOTHER HUGE THANK YOU to @/itsanette for her [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15026]Simple Resources[/url] mod which I used as a base (with permission!) for the terrain items.

AND a big thank you to the SDV modding discord community - y'all are so lovely and supportive
